title: Sentimen + deteksi sarkasme
description: Cek apakah ulasan bernada sarkas dan tentukan sikap asli penulis.

sarcasm.instructions: Is the writer being sarcastic, praising something while actually criticizing it?

criteria.false: the praise or complaint is meant literally
criteria.true: the praise is ironic, e.g. exaggerated praise followed by a complaint or refusal to buy again

real_attitude.instructions: Taking sarcasm and slang into account, what is the writer's REAL attitude toward the product or service?

criteria.negatif: genuinely dissatisfied, disappointed, or would not buy again
